WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_got_gpt,
        AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE WBC = 6.5
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_got_gpt) AS avg_of_status_avg_got_gpt,
    AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_of_status_avg_aptt_pt
FROM status_averages;
